name: Password Sign-In Requires MFA Selection
summary: The user submits valid password credentials for a durable identity that has both TOTP and Passkey available; the password proof succeeds, no authenticated application session is issued yet, and the client opens the Select MFA Type view.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active password-enabled durable identity has both TOTP and Passkey available for MFA

serverInteraction.intent: Accept valid password proof and return the generic MFA-required outcome without establishing an authenticated application session.

postconditions.expression: the durable identity remains anonymous to the application, password proof has succeeded, and the client presents both available MFA choices

sourceReferences.note: When both TOTP and Passkey are available, Password Sign In hands off to Select MFA Type rather than choosing a factor for the user.
The server transition remains the generic MFA-required password outcome; factor selection is client presentation.
Canonical client selection surface for identities with both supported MFA methods.
